brief:
Gaza children have returned to classrooms for the first time in three years, attending lessons in tents and makeshift structures as schools across the territory remain damaged or destroyed, Al Jazeera English reported. The resumption of education comes as families and aid organizations struggle with severe shortages of supplies and functional learning spaces.

The scale of infrastructure damage has forced schools to improvise with limited resources, with some classes operating in temporary shelters rather than traditional buildings. Students face ongoing challenges including inadequate materials and facilities as Gaza's education system attempts to rebuild following years of disruption.
dek: Gaza children return to classrooms after three years, facing challenges of damaged schools, tents, and scarce supplies.
title: Gaza's children resume classes in tents amid school destruction
